description: r0b0tlab's self-quantized ModelOpt NVFP4 W4A16 Qwen3.8 Flash Next (180B-A4B hybrid GDN + QSA sparse-attention MoE; BF16 NEXTN MTP tensors kept; 131 shards) on two Sparks with SGLang TP=2 over the fabric, from r0b0tlab/qwen38-flash-next-w4a16-sm121-sglang at 7bfacc51 (MIT). The checkpoint card declares licence 'other' and inherits the Qwen Community 1.0 terms of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. Runs upstream's published production full-context image (digest-pinned, SGLang source 7d2e8fcb with a small graph-observability overlay) with its qualified full-context NEXTN profile: Marlin FP4 GEMM and MoE, Triton attention, FP8 E4M3 target and draft KV, 262,144-token context without auto-truncation, up to 4 running requests, 20 Mamba slots, full decode CUDA graphs for batch sizes 1 to 4, embedding offload, memory fraction 0.90 and 3-step NEXTN speculation. The option switches speculation off (upstream's AR full-context profile). Upstream claims (not measured here): Q200-v2 188/200; dedicated c1 62.10 tok/s and short-request aggregate 63.84 / 83.66 / 132.64 tok/s at c1 / c2 / c4 on the promoted graph-on profile; full-window 261,504-token needle retrieval passes, with a full-window request needing about 138 s to first token. Vision is not claimed by upstream. Physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 W4A16 SGLang two Sparks (r0b0tlab)
